error_chain.expected_solution: Cross-repo propagation chain: (1) Next.js's webpack-config.ts injects an enhanced-resolve alias for transpilePackages so pnpm-symlinked workspace packages are visible to Webpack's resolver -> (2) Turbopack uses its own Rust resolver in turbopack-resolve/resolve.rs with a resolve_options_context that does not honor transpilePackages by default -> (3) When pnpm symlinks @internal/ui under apps/<app>/node_modules pointing to .pnpm/<store>/node_modules/@internal/ui, Webpack follows the symlink and loads the package -> (4) Turbopack's resolver, lacking the transpilePackages bridge, treats .pnpm-style nested links as outside the workspace root and refuses to load them, raising 'Module not found'.
